{{Quote|Finest speeders on Bespin! You can trust me, I'm Honest Grek.| Advertisements near Honest Grek's Speeders shop|<ref name="The Jewel of Yavin">''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]''</ref>}}
'''Honest Grek's Speeders''' was a shop owned by [[Honest Grek]] in the [[Industrial Levels]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Speeder/Legends|Speeders]], [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud cars]] and [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] could be found in the shop.

==Behind the Scenes==
[[File:Market_Row_map.jpg|thumb|left|''TJoY'' map indicating location of Honest Grek's Speeders (Labeled 10).|300px]]
Although ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'' describes Honest Grek's Speeders as being located in the [[Industrial Levels]], it ''depicts'' it firmly situated within [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]], only a few levels below [[Market Row]].
